name: Digoxin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Measure digoxin before starting; reduce the digoxin dose by about 30 to 50% or dose less often, and keep monitoring.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Amiodarone, propafenone, quinine, spironolactone, verapamil, mirabegron
key_interactions.effect: Digoxin exposure up by less than 50% (label).
key_interactions.action: Measure digoxin before starting; reduce the digoxin dose by about 15 to 30% or dose less often, and keep monitoring.
Monitor digoxin levels when starting, changing or stopping them.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: ACE inhibitors, ARBs, NSAIDs including COX-2 inhibitors
key_interactions.effect: A fall in GFR or tubular secretion can impair digoxin excretion (label).
key_interactions.action: Individualize the digoxin dose; monitor levels and kidney function.

key_interactions.effect: Additive AV-node effects: bradycardia, advanced or complete heart block (label).
More torsades de pointes, proarrhythmia or sudden death reported with digoxin (label).
Sudden potassium shift from muscle can cause arrhythmias (label).
Treating hypothyroidism may raise digoxin dose needs (label).
Transient hypercalcemia may predispose to digitalis toxicity (label).
